step_by_step_reasoning: The visual architecture depicts Edge Nodes (SuperNodes and Nodes) connecting to an Amazon EKS cluster and Amazon Kinesis Data Streams. EKS integrates with MongoDB for proximity clustering and Amazon DynamoDB for peer/profile metadata. For monitoring, Edge Nodes stream logs to Kinesis Data Streams, which feeds into Kinesis Data Firehose, archiving to Amazon S3. Snowflake queries S3 for real-time and long-term analytics.

edges.notes: Edge node registers with discovery service on EKS.
EKS registers proximity clustering data in MongoDB.
EKS manages profiles and associations in DynamoDB.
SuperNode streams API logs and telemetry to Kinesis Data Streams.
Data streams to Kinesis Data Firehose.
